observations.note: The eastern-end pavilion has a broad, white tensile canopy over an open-air audience/stage area.
A long, dark, freestanding chalk wall sits among the central trees, with walking routes on both sides.
The broad brick pedestrian corridor has a central tree/bench zone, generous side walking lanes, storefronts, and café patios.

interpretation: Used for original scene geometry and spatial reference. Video frames are not rehosted by the public site; chalk art is original community content. Scene spacing remains compressed and illustrative.
